temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual at work; when Jose asks if she is okay, she says it is personal stuff and thanks him, but does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is normally vibrant and has no known personal issue troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jose's suspicion that something is bothering Patricia is confirmed as a personal issue, though the details remain unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is dealing with some personal problem and may not be ready to discuss it, but she appreciates his concern.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer a listening ear and be available without pressing her for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; she later confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing budgeting help soon.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has an undisclosed personal problem and appreciates his support, but Jose does not know what it is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His concern deepens and becomes more specific: Patricia is under financial stress and may accept practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is struggling with bills and finances, and she is tentatively open to budgeting or financial-planning help when she feels ready.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern and empathy, with a cautious wish to help
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer financial planning or budgeting support and wait for her to indicate readiness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose raises his worry that he may have overstepped by bringing up finances; Patricia reassures him he was not prying and says she is grateful for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed and may be open to help, but Jose worries that his offer may have felt intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Patricia's reassurance resolves his boundary worry and confirms that she welcomes his supportive role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia does not think he overstepped; she is grateful for his help and sees him as someone she can turn to as a friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting her as a friend while respecting her privacy and not prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose asks how things are going; Patricia says all is good and she plans a quiet weekend at home, without elaborating. She thanks him when he offers availability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia welcomes his support, is grateful for it, and may still be dealing with financial stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, somewhat. Jose senses that Patricia prefers to handle her issues privately and does not want to discuss them in detail right now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but wants privacy and to manage her own issues; Jose should remain available without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern and acceptance, with some restraint
temporal_state_chain.intention: Give her space while maintaining a supportive presence and letting her initiate deeper help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in and offers help, even just grabbing coffee; Patricia says she is busy but handling it, thanks him for checking in, and says his support is great.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers privacy and is handling her issues herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; it confirms and reinforces his prior belief that she values his low-pressure support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling things and appreciates his supportive presence; continued friendly check-ins are welcome as long as they are not intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular, low-pressure supportive check-ins and remain available to help if she asks.
